A late fee may be waived at the servicer's discretion. A waiver request must be submitted before the fee is assessed; a fee that has already been charged is not removed automatically.

eval-en-en-03.content: Loan payments are due on the scheduled due date listed in the borrower agreement. Payments are applied first to outstanding interest, then to principal, unless otherwise required by the loan agreement.

If a borrower misses a payment, the loan enters a 10-day grace period. During the grace period, the borrower may make the payment without the loan being marked delinquent. If payment is not received by the end of the grace period, the loan becomes delinquent.
A late fee may be assessed after the grace period has expired. The amount of the late fee depends on the loan agreement and applicable rules.
